subject: CedarBank compliance check-in: SOC 2 evidence & retention pilot scope
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Clarke <sophie.clarke@cedarbank.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: CedarBank compliance check-in: SOC 2 evidence & retention pilot scope

Hi Sophie —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our side so we have alignment and clear next steps. High-level items you flagged as priorities:

- SOC 2 / attestation evidence (Type II) availability and summary of controls relevant to data access and retention.
- Audit logging: schema, retention options, and export mechanics for long-term archival (you mentioned 7+ years).
- DPA language and any required data residency/processing clarifications.
- Pen test expectations: scoping, timelines, and whether CedarBank needs evidence of Redwood's pen test vendors or will run an engage-your-vendor model.

What we heard about goals and constraints:
- Primary goal is demonstrable retention and auditability for regulator requests (7 years preferred; at minimum searchable exports on demand).
- Technical preference for S3-style export (presigned, encrypted) or direct SFTP; KMS-backed encryption is required.
- Procurement needs a redlined DPA before legal approval; security will need artifacts and a short timeline for review.

Proposed next steps (we committed these on the call):
1) Redwood to share a 1–2 page SOC 2 summary and an artifacts checklist (deliverable: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf) — due by EOD Thu, Jun 3.
2) Karthik to follow up with the audit log schema and a retention-export CSV illustrating fields and TTL options (attachment: retention-schema.csv) — due Jun 1.
3) Priyom to draft a pen-test scoping template and list of prerequisites (attachment: pen-test-scoping.xlsx) — due Jun 7; we also proposed an NDA/scoping call if you want to run your own vendor.
4) Schedule a technical deep-dive (45–60m) with your security/infra team to walk export flows, KMS integration, and routing policies — proposed window: Jun 4–6.
5) We will surface a DPA redline (DocuSign link) and a suggested retention SLA clause for your legal review — aim to have that ready Jun 7.

Attachments referenced above are included for your initial review.

If I missed anything or the priorities should be reordered, please reply inline. Otherwise, confirm the deep-dive availability (I sent a Calendly to Sophie separately).

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com | (415) 555-0198
Redwood Inference

Attachment: retention-schema.csv (CSV, 14 KB)
Attachment: pen-test-scoping.xlsx (XLSX, 28 KB)

From: Sophie Clarke <sophie.clarke@cedarbank.com>

Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@cedarbank.com>, security@cedarbank.com
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: CedarBank compliance check-in: SOC 2 evidence & retention pilot scope

Neha —

Appreciate the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side before the deep-dive:

1) KMS: we use AWS KMS with customer-managed CMKs for production keys. Can Redwood integrate with customer CMKs (via cross-account key policies) or do you require Redwood-managed keys?
2) Retention/export: 7 years is our target but we may accept a hybrid approach where we keep searchable logs for 90 days and produce full exports on request for older windows (we need the export to be queryable by timestamp and transaction-id).
3) Pen test: we'll likely run an internal vendor. We'll need Redwood to share a template and to confirm whether there are any environment constraints (e.g., staging/test stand requirements).
4) DPA: our procurement/legal team will need the redline. Please mark any high-risk clauses you expect to push back on.

Raj (cc'd) will join the technical deep-dive if available — he's security lead for app-level encryption and retention. Suggested time: Jun 4 at 9am PT — does that work for your team?

Thanks,
Sophie Clarke
Head of Compliance, CedarBank
sophie.clarke@cedarbank.com

Subject: Re: CedarBank compliance check-in: SOC 2 evidence & retention pilot scope

Sophie / Raj —

Following up with the technical details we discussed. High-level answers:

- SOC 2: Redwood maintains a SOC 2 Type II report covering our inference platform control set. We don't publish the full report publicly; we provide a redacted/summary copy under an NDA and can coordinate an uploader link to your secure review space. The summary we attached lists the controls most relevant to data access, change management, and incident response.

- KMS / Encryption at rest: We support AWS KMS with customer-managed keys (CMKs) in a cross-account setup for Dedicated and Private deployments. For Hosted customers we typically manage keys, but we offer Bring-Your-Own-Key for enterprise accounts via a scoped KMS arrangement — we can provide a checklist of required IAM roles/policies.

- Audit logs & exports: The audit log schema (attached) includes timestamp, request_id, model_id, route, user_id_hash (pseudonymized), token_count, and event_type. By default hosted logs are retained for 90 days in our hot store. For longer-term retention we provide two options:
  1) Continuous export to your S3 bucket (encrypted with your CMK) with lifecycle policies you control. Exports are newline-delimited JSON with a daily file per region.
  2) On-demand archival export (we generate a time-window export and push to presigned S3 link).

- Pen test process: We can accept "bring-your-vendor" assessments. Redwood will provide scope boundaries, test accounts, and a staging instance. We require a short scoping questionnaire and an executed NDA prior to any tests. If you prefer Redwood to run an engagement with our vendor, we can provide vendor CVs and prior scopes.

Links & artifacts:
- Retention example manifest: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cSOC2-CedarBank
- HubSpot record for tracking: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/87654/company/cedarbank

I attached a small pen-test scoping workbook (pen-test-scoping.xlsx) with fields we typically ask you to fill (IP ranges, acceptable test hours, critical endpoints). Happy to walk through this on the deep-dive.

--
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

Attachment: pen-test-scoping.xlsx (XLSX, 28 KB)

Sophie —

Thanks for the quick clarifications — and great, Raj joining is helpful. 9am PT on Jun 4 works for us; I booked a 60-minute slot and sent the invite to all.

To confirm agreed deliverables and timelines from Redwood:
- SOC 2 summary & artifacts checklist (redwood-soc2-summary.pdf) — delivery by Jun 3 EOD.
- Audit log schema + retention export example (retention-schema.csv) — already shared; Karthik will talk through details on Jun 4.
- Pen-test scoping workbook and NDA template (pen-test-scoping.xlsx + link to our NDA) — Priyom will send the NDA and the scoping workbook by Jun 7.
- DPA redline via DocuSign for your legal review — we aim to have the redline ready by Jun 7; link will be sent to procurement.
- Pilot kickoff: propose the week of Jun 21 for a 4-week retention pilot (we will scope S3 export to your bucket + weekly verification checks).

Next immediate actions for CedarBank:
1) Confirm the Jun 4 deep-dive attendee list (please include the person who owns the KMS/keys).
2) Confirm whether you prefer continuous export to your bucket or on-demand archival for the pilot.
3) If you plan to run your own pen-test vendor, share the name/contact so we can coordinate the NDA and scoping call.

Links for quick access: HubSpot record (https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/87654/company/cedarbank) and DPA DocuSign (https://www.docusign.com/link/DPA-RD-2027-0421).

If all good, we'll treat Jun 7 as the single-point legal artifact delivery date and waterfall items into the pilot kickoff on Jun 21.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
